title: ModifierList

external_id.description: A user-configured identifier for this object within the menu. External IDs must be unique across all menu entities of this type. Any modifier list that shares this `external_id` will be overwritten.

name.description: The display name for this list of modifiers.

modifiers.description: The `external_id` values of the `PosNormalizedModifier` objects referenced by this list.

items.description: The `external_id` values of the `PosNormalizedModifier` objects referenced by this list.

description: A list of modifiers included within a modifier prompt.
